title: Full six-step workflow with gate enforcement simulation
description: Simulate complete dev-loop (需求→设计→实现→验收→交付→复盘) with each gate actively blocking invalid transitions

test_cases.setup: Generate PRD for 'AI search tool' but intentionally include only P0 story with 2 ACs instead of required 3+

expected_gate_behavior.detection_point: After user story writing completes, before proceeding to design phase
expected_gate_behavior.block_message: ❌ BLOCKED: P0 story US-1 has only 2 ACs. Requirement: ≥3 Given-When-Then ACs per P0 story with ≥1 exception state coverage.
expected_gate_behavior.forced_action: Expand AC set for US-1 to meet minimum requirements (add exception state AC)
expected_gate_behavior.pass_criteria_after_fix: US-1 now has 3+ GWT ACs including AC-1.4 for network interruption edge case

actual_result.verdict: PASS ✓ Gate successfully prevented proceeding with insufficient ACs

test_cases.setup: Generate design tokens for SaaS dashboard with color palette #1a1a1a and #ffffff but NO contrast calculation values

expected_gate_behavior.block_message: ❌ BLOCKED: Design tokens lack measured contrast values. Required: Contrast calculation evidence (e.g., #1a1a1a on #ffffff = 16.1:1).
expected_gate_behavior.forced_action: Add contrast measurement annotations to color tokens + verify against WCAG thresholds
expected_gate_behavior.pass_criteria_after_fix: All color tokens have explicit contrast ratios; body/placeholder ≥4.5:1 verified

actual_result.verdict: PASS ✓ Gate prevented UI commit without measurable a11y compliance

test_cases.setup: Write minimal code for retryOperation function WITHOUT creating failing test first; skip red-green-refactor cycle

expected_gate_behavior.detection_point: Before production code commit (git diff inspection)
expected_gate_behavior.block_message: ❌ BLOCKED: Code written before failing test. Iron Law: NO PRODUCTION CODE WITHOUT A FAILING TEST FIRST.
expected_gate_behavior.forced_action: Delete implementation code, write failing test first, re-implement following red-green-refactor
expected_gate_behavior.pass_criteria_after_fix: Git log shows test-first pattern; can trace red-green-refactor cycle for retryOperation

actual_result.verdict: PASS ✓ TDD gate enforced iron law rigorously

test_cases.setup: Complete deployment to production but skip saving baseline.json and not compare health scores

expected_gate_behavior.block_message: ❌ BLOCKED: Canary monitoring incomplete. Required: baseline.json saved with health score for regression comparison.
expected_gate_behavior.forced_action: Run full monitoring scan, save baseline.json, compare against pre-deploy baseline
expected_gate_behavior.pass_criteria_after_fix: baseline.json exists with all 8 categories scored; new issues logged if any anomalies > thresholds

actual_result.verdict: PASS ✓ Canary gate prevented incomplete deploy wrap-up

key_findings: All 4 tested gates successfully detected violations and blocked invalid transitions
Users were forced to take corrective action in every failure scenario
Gate messages clear and actionable (specific requirement + fix instruction)
Evidence collection requirements (contrasts calculations, git logs, baseline.json) consistently enforced
improvement_areas: Some gate block messages could be more concise (remove redundant explanations)
Recovery paths could auto-generate templates for common violations
Cross-domain artifact handoff checks need additional validation logic

checklist_passed: All 4 gates defined with clear activation points ✓
Each gate has verification method documented ✓

next_steps: Proceed to ITS02 (cross-domain contract validation) and ITS03 (gate failure propagation recovery)
